help.recordDescription: Listen to the original, press record, and speak. Press stop when you finish.
help.watchDescription: Your recording replaces your character’s lines. Other characters keep their original voices.
help.recordingAdvice: Headphones work best. Green shows the original audio, orange shows your voice, and the cursor shows the current time. Waveforms show loudness, not pronunciation scores; the original includes music and effects. Dubs save in this browser. Continue or delete them in My dubs. No uploads. On phones, use Safari or Chrome; recording inside WeChat has not been verified.
help.guardianConsent: Currently for you and your colleagues to test. Before a child uses it, a guardian must understand and agree to the recording purpose.
